name: Crescent Dream
look: a pterosaur Cresselia with immense curved pink crescent wings, a shaggy cream mane tipped with green, a long tan beak and crest under a pink cap, fluffy blue legs and swirling gold crescent ribbons behind it
entry: A Pokémon resembling Cresselia, described in a cave painting of a great winged reptile that soared under the crescent moon. Sleepers it flew over were said to dream of flight.
how: Wild: very rare at night in cherry groves and groves.
